verdict_reason: The query-string swaps are sound, but two rows check the removed Branch role is absent, and option-label matching is no longer proven by any test.

todos.issue: The rows ['branch', []] and ['branch address', []] (view-model/list.test.js:194-195) prove that a removed role no longer matches: an absence check on history, and the same proof as the ['farm', []] row below them.
todos.fix: Must: the rolesWhoseLabelContains table names no removed role, and its no-match case is proven once. One way: delete the two branch rows and keep ['farm', []].

todos.issue: The title 'Should give the roles whose Type column label or Type option label contains %j, ignoring case' (view-model/list.test.js:198) claims option-label matching, but with BRANCH_ADDRESS gone every role's optionLabel equals its columnLabel ignoring case (copy.en.js:58-67, copy.cy.js:61-70). Deleting optionLabel from rolesWhoseLabelContains (view-model/list.js:57-61) turns no test red. The tests that used to prove it were rewritten onto Importer, whose labels are the same: list.type-filter.controller.test.js:395 and fit/list.fit.spec.js:794.
todos.fix: Must: either a test fails when option-label matching is removed, or rolesWhoseLabelContains matches only the label the copy can tell apart and its title says so. One way: since no role's option label differs any more, match columnLabel alone and drop 'or Type option label' from the title.
